items.stem: Which TWO are true about the .NET MAUI single project? (Select TWO.)

options.text: One shared project can target Android, iOS, macOS and Windows
options.rationale: Correct: a single project multi-targets several platforms.

options.text: Platform-specific code lives in the Platforms folder and is built only for that platform
options.rationale: Correct: the build includes each Platforms subfolder only for its platform.

options.text: You must create one separate project per target platform
options.rationale: The single project removes the need for per-platform projects.

options.text: Shared resources must be duplicated into each platform folder
options.rationale: Resources are shared in the single project.
